groups.meta: bank Ducats and credits before Baro arrives

rows.label: open relics, take the highest-Ducat part
rows.note: gold 100, silver 45, bronze 15; former-vault parts 25 or 65

rows.label: sell duplicate Prime parts at the Kiosk
rows.note: about five gold or nine silver parts

conditions: Baro stays only 48 hours, so have the 410 Ducats and 200,000 credits banked before his visit.
bonuses: Some players buy 45-Ducat junk parts from others for about 2 platinum each.

groups.activity: check Baro's rotating stock, then buy if listed

live.text: check the Ducat Kiosk countdown for his next relay

rows.label: Vericres
rows.note: 200,000 credits + 410 Ducats, only when in his rotating stock
rows.alt: tradeable, so another player can sell you one

conditions: It appears roughly every four to six months and can't be predicted; buy it the first time it shows up.
It arrives built with no Orokin Catalyst and needs a free melee slot. MR 8 to equip.
bonuses: The TennoCon relay sells Baro's full catalogue, but entry needs a paid TennoCon digital ticket.

disclosures.title: a Mastery pickup
disclosures.body: Recaps call it a decent but unremarkable warfan and point to Gunsen Prime, Quassus Prime or Arum Spinosa for actual use.
